lines.en: label halloweentwo7:
if amilust20 == True:
scene cupcaketable1
By the time we make it back, Ami still hasn’t fully recovered.
lines.zh: 等我们回来的时候，Ami 还没完全缓过来。

lines.en: I’m hoping that ends soon, though, as her continuing to address herself in third person after disappearing with me will be suspicious for a number of reasons.
lines.zh: 不过我希望她快点恢复正常，因为要是她在跟我消失一趟之后还继续用第三人称称呼自己，出于好几个原因都会显得很可疑。

lines.en: I don’t think the initial assumption for any of those reasons will be particularly sexual, though, because...well, a change in speech patterns isn't normally a result of that.
lines.zh: 但我倒不觉得这些原因里最初那条会特别跟性有关，因为……嗯，说话方式的改变通常不是那方面造成的。

lines.en: But it would be suspicious nonetheless.
lines.zh: 但那终究还是很可疑。

lines.en: I’m counting on you, Ami.
lines.zh: 我就指望你了，Ami。
: 呃呃呃呃呃呃呃呃呃…………………………

lines.en: : You doing okay, Ami?
lines.zh: : 你还好吗，Ami？

lines.en: scene cupcaketable2
: Yup! Totally normal Ami here! Nothing to worry about!
lines.zh: : 好！这里是完全正常的 Ami！没什么好担心的！

lines.en: Hell yeah.
lines.zh: 太棒了。

lines.en: : Anything...fun happen while we were gone?
lines.zh: : 我们不在的时候……有什么好玩的事吗？

lines.en: else:
scene cupcaketable2
: Hey! Sorry we were gone for so long.
lines.zh: : 嘿！抱歉我们离开了这么久。

lines.en: : No need to be sorry! I’m sure the “Hall of many bathrooms” can be a little hard the first few times.
lines.zh: : 不用道歉！我敢肯定那座「好多洗手间之家」头几次走起来确实有点难。

lines.en: : You’ll get the hang of it one day, Ami.
lines.zh: : 总有一天你会摸清门路的，Ami。

lines.en: : No, Ayane.
lines.zh: : 不会的，Ayane。

lines.en: : No I will not.
lines.zh: : 我不会的。

lines.en: Ami and I make it back to the party after giving up on our search for Noriko and take our places at the “Primarily manga club” table.
lines.zh: 放弃寻找 Noriko 之后，我和 Ami 回到派对上，在「基本都是漫画社」那张桌前各自坐下。

lines.en: I’m not really sure how these girls organize their cliques, but that’s what I’m going to call this table until someone gives it a better name.
lines.zh: 我不太清楚这些女生是怎么划分小圈子的，但在有人给它起个更好的名字之前，我就这么叫这张桌子了。

lines.en: Even if...only two of the girls here are in that club.
lines.zh: 哪怕……这里其实只有两个女生是那个社的。

lines.en: : So...did anything fun happen while we were gone?
lines.zh: : 那么……我们不在的时候有什么好玩的事吗？

lines.en: scene cupcaketable3
: Fun? No.
lines.zh: : 好玩？没有。

lines.en: : But Uta-nyan tried to teach Tsuneyo her flavor beam technique and failed miserably before being summoned over by a bunch of the others to...do something.
lines.zh: : 不过 Uta-nyan 试着把她的风味光线教给 Tsuneyo，结果惨败，然后就被一群人叫过去……做什么事去了。

lines.en: : I became distracted by cupcakes and stopped paying attention.
lines.zh: : 我的注意力被纸杯蛋糕勾走了，之后就没再留意。

lines.en: : That makes sense.
lines.zh: : 这很合理。

lines.en: : I think it was a game.
lines.zh: : 我觉得那大概是个游戏。

lines.en: : It’s rare to see food in front of you that has...yet to be eaten, Maya.
lines.zh: : 很少能看到你面前摆着……还没被吃掉的食物啊，Maya。

lines.en: scene cupcaketable4
: You...You do know how food works, correct? Eating it is what you are supposed to do.
lines.zh: : 你……你总该知道食物是怎么回事吧？吃掉它才是你该做的事。

lines.en: : Yes, Maya. I’m not a fucking idiot. I just meant that you-
lines.zh: : 知道，Maya。我又不是他妈的白痴。我只是说你——

lines.en: : Yes, yes. Maya eats a lot and somehow still manages to stay skinny. We know.
lines.zh: : 好好好。Maya 吃得很多，却不知怎么还能保持那么瘦。我们都懂。

lines.en: scene cupcaketable5
: What does my weight have to do with anything? That wasn’t even brought up.
lines.zh: : 我的体重跟这有什么关系？这根本不是话题吧。

lines.en: : I know. I just get annoyed by how pretty you are sometimes and then my jealousy leaks out without me realizing it.
lines.zh: : 我知道。我只是有时候会因为你太漂亮而烦躁，然后嫉妒心就这么不知不觉漏出来了。

lines.en: : Oh. Well, thank you.
lines.zh: : 哦。那，谢谢。

lines.en: : While we’re on the topic of looking pretty, do you notice anything different about Sana, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 既然说到好不好看，Sensei，你有没有注意到 Sana 哪里不一样了？

lines.en: : You mean apart from her gas mask that has now gone missing?
lines.zh: : 你是说除了她那个现在已经不知去向的防毒面具之外？

lines.en: : My...hair is a little different too, but...I’m sure you didn’t notice...
lines.zh: : 我的……头发也有点不一样，不过……我想你肯定没注意到……

lines.en: : Oh. Yeah, not really.
lines.zh: : 哦。对，确实没怎么注意。

lines.en: : I always notice when your other eye is showing, though. So that has to be good for something.
lines.zh: : 不过你另一只眼睛露出来的时候，我每次都注意到了。所以这总得有点用吧。

lines.en: scene cupcaketable6
: Sensei! Always pretend that you notice when a girl changes her hair, even if you don’t!
lines.zh: : Sensei！就算你没注意到，女生换了发型你也一定要装作注意到了啊！

lines.en: : Are you telling me to live a life of lies, Ayane? I would never hide anything from you girls.
lines.zh: : 你是在叫我活在谎言里吗，Ayane？我对你们这些女生可是从来没有任何隐瞒的。

lines.en: : You’re literally lying right now.
lines.zh: : 你现在就在撒谎啊。

lines.en: : I’m not asking you to lie! Just to...be a little nicer.
lines.zh: : 我不是要你撒谎！只是……稍微温柔一点。

lines.en: : Sana has now been brave enough to show us her belly twice! Once during the dorm war and once now!
lines.zh: : Sana 现在已经勇敢到给我们看了两次肚子了！一次是宿舍战争的时候，一次就是现在！

lines.en: : She deserves all of the love and encouragement we have to offer!
lines.zh: : 她配得上我们能给的所有爱和鼓励！

lines.en: : Ayane...you...don’t have to...say all that...
lines.zh: : Ayane……你……不用……说这些的……

lines.en: : Well, it’s definitely true that this “costume” is a bit more revealing than what she normally wears.
lines.zh: : 嗯，有一点是肯定的：这套「装扮」确实比她平时穿的暴露那么一点。

lines.en: : I just figured pointing it out would make her embarrassed and cause her to run away and I really don’t want to get caught in the bathroom labyrinth again.
lines.zh: : 我只是觉得指出来会让她难为情，然后一跑了之，而我可真不想再被困在那个洗手间迷宫里了。

lines.en: scene cupcaketable7
: It’s...actually not as confusing as it seems...
lines.zh: : 其实……没有看上去那么让人摸不着头脑……

lines.en: : You just have to kind of...memorize which directions you went in and...stuff...
lines.zh: : 你只要……大概记住自己走过哪些方向……什么的……

lines.en: : Yes. Because, as we all know, I have the best memory around.
lines.zh: : 是啊。毕竟众所周知，我的记性是最好的。

lines.en: : Besides, it’s not like this was a conscious decision, was it? You just raided your mom’s closet and, presumably, chose the weirdest shit you could find.
lines.zh: : 再说了，这又不是你深思熟虑之后的选择，对吧？你只是翻了你妈的衣柜，然后大概挑了你能找到的最怪的东西。

lines.en: scene cupcaketable8
: Um...yeah...
: Of course I’d never...put thought into looking like...this...
lines.zh: : 我当然不可能……为了看起来像……这样……而花心思……

lines.en: : I just felt...obligated to dress up, I guess...
lines.zh: : 我只是觉得……有义务打扮一下吧……

lines.en: : Sensei! You’re ruining our chances of ever seeing Sana’s belly again by not validating her!
lines.zh: : Sensei！你不去认可她，会毁掉我们下次再看到 Sana 肚子的机会的！

lines.en: : Uhh...it’s a good belly?
lines.zh: : 呃……那是个好肚子？

lines.en: scene cupcaketable9
: N-N-N-N-No it’s not! Stop looking!
lines.zh: : 才、才、才、才不是！别看！

lines.en: : I have no idea what I am supposed to be doing right now.
lines.zh: : 我完全不知道现在该做什么。

lines.en: : You are making that quite clear.
lines.zh: : 你表现得相当明显。

lines.en: : Is it your turn to be validated, Maya?
lines.zh: : 轮到需要被认可的是你吗，Maya？

lines.en: : Will complimenting you now open up more opportunities for you to wear costumes in the future? Or should I just savor this moment while it lasts?
lines.zh: : 现在夸你，能让你以后有更多机会穿角色扮演服装吗？还是说我该趁现在好好品味这一刻？

lines.en: scene cupcaketable10
: Complimenting me is literally pointless when I would choose any one of these five cupcakes over you any day of the week.
lines.zh: : 夸我根本毫无意义，反正一周七天里随便哪天，我都会选这五个纸杯蛋糕里的任何一个，也不会选你。

lines.en: : You can compliment me, Sensei!
lines.zh: : 你可以夸我啊，Sensei！

lines.en: if amihalloween2win == True:
: Was winning the contest earlier not enough for you?
lines.zh: : 之前赢了比赛还不够吗？

lines.en: : It’s never enough! Give me more love!
lines.zh: : 永远都不够！多给我点爱！

lines.en: : Give me everything! I want it all!
lines.zh: : 全都给我！我全都要！

lines.en: : Jesus, calm down.
lines.zh: : 老天，冷静点。

lines.en: elif ayanehalloween2win == True:
: Or me! Compliment me!
lines.zh: : 或者我！夸我！

lines.en: : I already complimented you earlier when I chose your costume over all of the others.
lines.zh: : 我之前已经夸过你了啊，我在那么多套里选了你的装扮。

lines.en: : True. But after I called the limo for the backseat stuff you requested, you never showed up and it hurt my feelings!
lines.zh: : 确实。但在我为你要求的那些后座事情叫了那辆豪华轿车之后，你根本没出现，这伤了我的心！

lines.en: : How would you have even explained-
lines.zh: : 你打算怎么解释——

lines.en: : You know what? Nevermind. I don’t want to know.
lines.zh: : 你知道吗？算了。我不想知道了。

lines.en: else:
: I compliment you like every day. Isn’t that enough?
lines.zh: : 我每天都夸你。这还不够吗？

lines.en: : Nope.
lines.zh: : 不够。

lines.en: : You only compliment me every other day. Can I have one?
lines.zh: : 你只是隔天夸我一次。我能要一个吗？

lines.en: : No. The time for compliments is over.
lines.zh: : 不行。夸奖时间已经结束了。

lines.en: : Maya, would you really choose the cupcakes over me?
lines.zh: : Maya，你真的会选纸杯蛋糕不选我？

lines.en: : Without a second thought.
lines.zh: : 想都不用想。

lines.en: : Really?
lines.zh: : 真的？

lines.en: : Yes.
lines.zh: : 真的。

lines.en: : Even after-
lines.zh: : 就算在——

lines.en: : Yes.
lines.zh: : 真的。

lines.en: : But-
lines.zh: : 可是——

lines.en: : Cupcakes.
lines.zh: : 纸杯蛋糕。

lines.en: scene cupcaketable11
: It’s not like Maya needs the compliments or anything anyway. She’s not like Sana or Ayane or me.
lines.zh: : Maya 又不需要什么夸奖。她跟 Sana、Ayane 还有我都不一样。

lines.en: : How am I not like any of you?
lines.zh: : 我怎么就不一样了？

lines.en: : Because you’re confident, obviously.
lines.zh: : 因为你很自信啊，很明显。

lines.en: : So is Ayane. You and Sana are the ones with self-esteem issues.
lines.zh: : Ayane 也很自信。有自尊问题的是你和 Sana。

lines.en: : Not that I want to be complimented in the first place. I’m just pointing out the flaws in your logic.
lines.zh: : 而且我也没说想要被夸。我只是在指出你逻辑上的漏洞。

lines.en: scene cupcaketable12
: Hah...I know...
lines.zh: : 哈……我知道……

lines.en: : It’s my fault for not believing in myself. It’s just hard when you’ve been pretty much the same way ever since we met.
lines.zh: : 都怪我自己不相信自己。只是从我们认识以来你基本一直是那个样子，这让我很难。

lines.en: : You’re always so sure of yourself but, like...at the same time, it’s like you don’t even care.
lines.zh: : 你总是那么笃定，可是……与此同时，又好像你根本不在乎。

lines.en: : And you don’t do anything to keep it up and it’s just...so natural for you.
lines.zh: : 而且你什么都不做去维持它，对你来说就是……那么自然。

lines.en: : Why are you making yourself sound like an undesirable slob? You’re the cutest girl at this table.
lines.zh: : 你干嘛要把自己说成是个没人要的邋遢鬼？你是这张桌子上最可爱的女生。

lines.en: : No offense to Sana and Ayane.
lines.zh: : 无意冒犯 Sana 和 Ayane。

lines.en: scene cupcaketable13
: None taken!
lines.zh: : 不介意！

lines.en: : I...think that’s fine, too...
lines.zh: : 我……觉得也没关系……

lines.en: : See, it's hearing that exact sort of thing from you all the time that makes it so hard for me to believe that!
lines.zh: : 你看，就是总听你说这种话，我才那么难相信啊！

lines.en: : Come to think of it, you’ve always been really supportive of Ami, haven’t you?
lines.zh: : 说起来，你一直都很支持 Ami，对吧？

lines.en: : Sure. I guess.
lines.zh: : 算是吧。大概。

lines.en: : I just think she’s cute. Why is this becoming a thing?
lines.zh: : 我只是觉得她可爱。这事怎么就变成一个话题了？

lines.en: : Also, why is the only thing you grabbed off of the buffet table corn? That is what we should be talking about right now. Not our thoughts on each other's aesthetics.
lines.zh: : 还有，你从自助餐桌上只拿了玉米是几个意思？我们现在该聊的是这个，不是对彼此外貌的看法。

lines.en: I’ve been all but removed from the conversation.
lines.zh: 我已经基本被排除在这段对话之外了。

lines.en: But that’s okay, because I know that any minute now, I’ll be forced to make yet another choice about who I think is prettier.
lines.zh: 不过没关系，因为我知道再过一分钟，我就又会被迫在「谁更漂亮」这件事上做出选择。

lines.en: scene cupcaketable14
: What do you think, Sensei? Am I cuter than Maya?
lines.zh: : 你觉得呢，Sensei？我比 Maya 可爱吗？

lines.en: See?
lines.zh: 看吧？

lines.en: : No. You stay out of this. Why are you even at our table? This is reserved for costumed guests only.
lines.zh: : 不行。你别插嘴。你凭什么坐在我们这桌？这桌只招待穿了装扮的客人。

lines.en: : If that’s the case, Sana needs to leave too. That doesn’t count as a real costume if she doesn’t even know what it is.
lines.zh: : 那这么说 Sana 也该走人。她连自己穿的是什么都不知道，那算不上真正的装扮。

lines.en: if sanahalloween2win == True:
: It’s certainly more than no costume, and that didn’t dissuade you at all from still choosing her as the cutest earlier.
lines.zh: : 但总比什么都没穿要强，而且这也没妨碍你之前照样选她当最可爱的那个。

lines.en: : Okay. But it’s still not a costume.
lines.zh: : 好吧。但它依旧不算装扮。

lines.en: : Shut up.
lines.zh: : 闭嘴。

lines.en: scene cupcaketable13
: Why have you always been so supportive of me, Maya?
lines.zh: : 你为什么一直都这么支持我啊，Maya？

lines.en: : Like, you’ve probably called me cute more than Sensei has. And I force him to do it on a near daily basis.
lines.zh: : 你说我可爱大概比 Sensei 说得还多。而我可是逼着他几乎每天都说的。

lines.en: : I’m not being forced to do anything.
lines.zh: : 我可没被逼着做任何事。

lines.en: : Is everyone just unified in thinking that there needs to be some ulterior motive in me thinking you’re cute? Why is this happening?
lines.zh: : 所以大家都一致认为，我觉得你可爱就一定有什么不可告人的动机？这到底是怎么回事？

lines.en: scene cupcaketable15
: Because it’s annoying hearing that from you!
lines.zh: : 因为听你那么说很烦啊！

lines.en: : But...why?
lines.zh: : 可是……为什么？

lines.en: : Because I’ve always wanted to be more like you! You’re confident and cool and smart and stylish and pretty!
lines.zh: : 因为我一直都想变得更像你！你自信、酷、聪明、有品味，还漂亮！

lines.en: : Again, Ayane exists-
lines.zh: : 再说一遍，Ayane 也存在——

lines.en: : Ayane is just confident, smart and...kind of pretty, I guess!
lines.zh: : Ayane 只是自信、聪明，还有……勉强算漂亮吧！

lines.en: scene cupcaketable16
: Hey! I’m cool! Sensei thinks I’m cool!
lines.zh: : 嘿！我也很酷！Sensei 觉得我酷！

lines.en: : Oh, good. I still exist after all.
lines.zh: : 哦，好。看来我还确实存在着。

lines.en: scene cupcaketable17
: You’re just...I don’t know.
lines.zh: : 你就是……我不知道。

lines.en: : I’m glad you’re so nice to me all the time, but it’s just hard figuring out if it’s real or not.
lines.zh: : 你一直对我这么好，我很高兴，可是很难分辨那到底是不是真的。

lines.en: : So when you’re all like “Oh Ami, you’re the cutest girl at the table” when you’re at the same table it’s like “Ahhhhhhhhh Mayaaaaaa!!!!” you know?
lines.zh: : 所以当你明明就在同一张桌子上，还一个劲地说「哦 Ami，你是桌上最可爱的女生」的时候，感觉就像「啊啊啊啊啊啊 Mayaaaaaa！！！！」你知道吧？

lines.en: : Not...really?
lines.zh: : 不……太懂？

lines.en: scene cupcaketable18
: Hah...whatever. Forget it.
lines.zh: : 哈……算了。当我没说。

lines.en: : Soooo...Halloween! Right?
lines.zh: : 那~~~~~么……万圣节！对吧？

lines.en: : I can’t tell if that exchange was a fight or a bonding experience.
lines.zh: : 我说不清刚才那段到底是吵架还是增进感情。

lines.en: : Just ask Maya what she thinks and go with that. You’re just gonna side with her anyway.
lines.zh: : 问 Maya 怎么想然后照做就行了。反正你最后都会站她那边。

lines.en: : Why would Sensei side with me over you in literally any scenario?
lines.zh: : 在任何情况下，Sensei 凭什么会站我这边而不站你？

lines.en: scene cupcaketable19
: I don’t know, Maya. Why would he?
lines.zh: : 我不知道啊，Maya。为什么呢？

lines.en: : If I’m the perfect [niece] and everything Sensei needs wrapped into one little package, what reason would he have to do something like that?
lines.zh: : 如果我是那个完美的 [niece]，是 Sensei 所需要的一切打包成的一个小包裹，那他有什么理由去做那种事？

lines.en: : Okay. So it’s definitely a fight.
lines.zh: : 好吧。那这绝对是吵架。

lines.en: : Ami...All Maya did was compliment you. There’s no reason to get all...like this.
lines.zh: : Ami……Maya 只是夸了你而已。没必要搞得……这么……

lines.en: : Oh, come on. You know she’s been warming up to him lately. She barely even calls him disgusting anymore.
lines.zh: : 拜托。你明明知道她最近一直在跟他亲近。她现在都很少叫他恶心了。

lines.en: : I literally just said that I would take any one of these five cupcakes over him like two minutes ago.
lines.zh: : 我两分钟前才刚说过，我随便拿这五个纸杯蛋糕里的任何一个换他。

lines.en: : Yeah, you say a lot of things.
lines.zh: : 是啊，你的话是很多。

lines.en: : And sure, I don’t understand most of them, but I’m not as stupid as you think.
lines.zh: : 当然，大部分我都听不懂，但我可没你想的那么蠢。

lines.en: scene cupcaketable20
: Are you okay?
lines.zh: : 你还好吗？

lines.en: : I really wasn’t trying to start-
lines.zh: : 我真的不是想挑起——

lines.en: : Blah blah blah Maya is the cutest girl at the table and Ami is just Ami. Let’s move on.
lines.zh: : blah blah blah，Maya 是桌上最可爱的女生，Ami 就只是 Ami。我们翻篇吧。

lines.en: : Ami...
lines.zh: : Ami……

lines.en: : That’s my name!
lines.zh: : 那是我的名字！

lines.en: : I’m going to second Maya’s question and ask if you’re okay. You’re acting weird all of a sudden.
lines.zh: : 我也附议 Maya 的问题，问你还好吗。你突然变得怪怪的。

lines.en: Did I...fuck her so hard that she turned into a different person?
lines.zh: 我是不是……把她操得太狠，把她操成另一个人了？

lines.en: : I’ve just been losing sleep lately. I’m probably cranky.
lines.zh: : 我就是最近有点缺觉。大概是有点暴躁。

lines.en: : Is there any reason why? Or...
lines.zh: : 有什么原因吗？还是……

lines.en: : Nope! Just a thing that happens sometimes.
lines.zh: : 没有！就是偶尔会发生的事。

lines.en: : I wouldn’t worry about it unless I start getting a fever.
lines.zh: : 除非我开始发烧，否则你不用担心。

lines.en: : Do you want to lay down? I can ask Geoffrey to get off the phone with the Irish Mafia and set up a futon for you.
lines.zh: : 你想躺一会儿吗？我可以让 Geoffrey 挂掉跟爱尔兰黑手党的电话，给你铺个褥子。

lines.en: : Or you could go back to the main house and use my bed. I don’t really mind.
lines.zh: : 或者你可以回主宅用我的床。我真的不介意。

lines.en: : Can we not just gloss over the Irish Mafia thing?
lines.zh: : 我们能别就这么轻描淡写地略过爱尔兰黑手党那件事吗？

lines.en: scene cupcaketable21
: Is he really dealing with them again? I thought he moved past that confusing, yet suspiciously depressing and dramatic stage of his life.
lines.zh: : 他又在跟他们打交道了？我还以为他已经走过了人生中那个让人费解、却又可疑地丧气又戏剧化的阶段了。

lines.en: : Oh, you know Geoffrey. Always getting up to no good.
lines.zh: : 哦，你也知道 Geoffrey 的。总是没个消停。

lines.en: : What?
lines.zh: : 什么？

lines.en: scene cupcaketable22
Maya shoots me a look that, without any words, says something along the lines of “Just let it happen.”
lines.zh: Maya 朝我使了个眼色，那眼神没说一个字，意思却大致是「随它去吧」。

lines.en: I’m sure she’s just glad that whatever Ami’s minor outburst there was over, but I’d be a liar if I said I wasn’t interested in finding out a little more.
lines.zh: 我敢肯定她只是庆幸 Ami 那点小爆发总算过去了，但如果我说自己没兴趣再多知道一点，那我就是在撒谎。

lines.en: I mean, I’d be a liar even if I didn’t say that. Lying is kind of my thing. But that’s beside the point.
lines.zh: 我是说，就算我不说，我也还是个骗子。撒谎本来就是我的专长。不过这不是重点。

lines.en: I don’t want to step on Maya’s toes (Mostly due to the fact that they would shatter into a million pieces) but I feel like if I don’t, this could snowball into something bigger.
lines.zh: 我不想踩 Maya 的脚趾（主要是因为那脚趾会碎成上百万片），但我觉得如果我不踩，这事说不定会滚雪球越滚越大。

lines.en: “How much bigger” is a question that, unfortunately, none of us would be able to answer right now...but it’s certainly a concern.
lines.zh: 至于「能有多大」这个问题，很遗憾，眼下我们谁也答不上来……但这确实是个隐忧。

lines.en: The look doesn’t fade- but as I slide my hands into my pockets and begin to let Maya have her way, I think back to something Ami said just minutes ago.
lines.zh: 那个眼神并没有消失——但当我把双手插进兜里，开始让 Maya 遂心如意的时候，我想起了 Ami 几分钟前说过的一句话。

lines.en: That “I’m just going to side with her anyway.”
lines.zh: 那句「反正你最后都会站她那边」。

lines.en: Is that what I’m doing right now?
lines.zh: 我现在就是在做那件事吗？

lines.en: Am I disregarding Ami’s feelings and just rolling with what Maya wants because I...think she knows stuff?
lines.zh: 我是不是在无视 Ami 的感受，顺着 Maya 的心意走，就因为我……觉得她知道些什么？

lines.en: And, if that’s true...how does Ami know about it?
lines.zh: 而如果真是这样……Ami 又是怎么知道的？

lines.en: At the end of the day, Maya doesn’t know anything anymore.
lines.zh: 说到底，Maya 现在什么都不知道了。

lines.en: Well, close to anything.
lines.zh: 好吧，接近于什么都不知道。

lines.en: She still knows how the resets work for the most part. Probably.
lines.zh: 重置的运作方式她大体上还是知道的。大概吧。

lines.en: But she’s just as lost as everyone else concerning the rest of the world.
lines.zh: 至于这个世界的其他部分，她和大家一样茫然。

lines.en: : And that’s why Geoffrey had to sell one of his kidneys.
lines.zh: : 所以 Geoffrey 才不得不卖掉了自己的一颗肾。

lines.en: : What a...brave man...
lines.zh: : 好……勇敢的男人……

lines.en: : That still doesn’t explain the koala, though.
lines.zh: : 可那还是解释不了考拉的事啊。

lines.en: : Jesus, how much did I miss just now?
lines.zh: : 天哪，我刚刚到底错过了多少？

lines.en: scene cupcaketable23
: Do you want to meet him, Sensei?! He should be off the phone any minute now!
lines.zh: : 你想见他吗，Sensei？！他应该马上就打完电话了！

lines.en: : Sure. I guess it wouldn’t hurt to finally meet your-
lines.zh: : 好啊。我想终于见见你的——

lines.en: : Senseiiiiiii! Taaaaaaaaaable!!!!!!!!
lines.zh: : Senseiiiiiii！桌——————子！！！！！！！

lines.en: : Or not. I have been, once again, summoned by a girl who I am contractually obligated to prioritize over any male.
lines.zh: : 看来是不用了。我又一次被一个我在合同上有义务优先于任何男性对待的女生召唤了。

lines.en: I signal to Rin that I’ll be there in just a second before attempting to figure out how to end this conversation in a way that doesn’t make everything that happened totally meaningless.
lines.zh: 我朝 Rin 打了个手势，表示我马上就过去，然后开始琢磨该怎么结束这段对话，才不至于让刚才发生的一切变得毫无意义。

lines.en: The issue with that is that I get stuck on some pole I don’t know the name of in a course of mental gymnastics centered around the idea that everything is inherently meaningless.
lines.zh: 问题在于，我卡在了一根叫不出名字的单杠上，在一场以「一切本质上都毫无意义」为中心的思维体操里打转。

lines.en: And if that much is true, it means that there’s nothing I can say to anyone right now that would either rationalize or explain what happened because...
lines.zh: 而如果这一点成立，那意味着我现在对任何人说的任何话，都无法把发生的事合理化或解释清楚，因为……

lines.en: Well, some things just happen because they happen.
lines.zh: 嗯，有些事就是发生了，因为它是会发生的。

lines.en: Girls fight. Best friends are no exception.
lines.zh: 女生会吵架。最好的朋友也不例外。

lines.en: Maya called Ami cute. Ami thinks Maya is cute and used that as an excuse to do some venting.
lines.zh: Maya 夸了 Ami 可爱。Ami 觉得 Maya 可爱，并拿这个当借口发泄了一通。

lines.en: Is this the time and place for that? Of course not. But it’s a thing that happened and it’s not on any of us to judge her for it when we already know her self-control is about as solid as a...marshmallow?
lines.zh: 现在是做这件事的时间和场合吗？当然不是。但这是已经发生的事，既然我们都知道她的自制力大概跟……棉花糖差不多结实，那也轮不到我们来评判她。

lines.en: I try to think of things that are pretty solid, but not too solid for the sake of my metaphor.
lines.zh: 我努力想一些挺结实、但又为了比喻不至于太结实的东西。

lines.en: I think I succeed.
lines.zh: 我觉得我成功了。

lines.en: Anyway, here is what I came up with for my wise parting words to mend the first signs of fraying threads in Ami and Maya’s relationship.
lines.zh: 总之，下面就是我想出来用来修补 Ami 和 Maya 关系里最初那几缕起毛的线的睿智临别赠言。

lines.en: : I’ll talk to you later, I guess.
lines.zh: : 那我晚点再跟你聊吧。

lines.en: scene cupcaketable24
: Okay!
: Don’t stare at Futaba’s boobs for too long. If you do, they’ll entrance you and you won’t love me anymore.
lines.zh: : 别盯着 Futaba 的胸看太久。看久了你会被勾走魂，然后就不爱我了。

lines.en: : That is a tall order.
lines.zh: : 这要求可不低。

lines.en: : Besides, you know I don’t love you for your chest.
lines.zh: : 再说了，你知道我爱的又不是你的胸。

lines.en: : That’s probably because there’s nothing there yet.
lines.zh: : 那大概是因为那儿还没什么东西吧。

lines.en: scene cupcaketable25
: Love you.
lines.zh: : 爱你。

lines.en: : Okay, then. Later.
lines.zh: : 好吧，那就。回见。

lines.en: scene black
I slowly back away from the table just as it's overtaken by the scornful aura of a [niece] undeveloped.
lines.zh: 我缓缓从桌边退开，那张桌子正好被一个发育不良的 [niece] 那股怨气给吞没了。

lines.en: But if I listen closely enough, I can still hear the burning desire to survive and grow dripping off of their cupcake-laden tablecloth.
lines.zh: 但如果我凑近了听，还是能听见那股想要活下去、想要长大的灼热渴望，从她们那块沾满纸杯蛋糕的桌布上滴下来。

lines.en: $ halloweentwo7 = True
$ ami_love += 1
Ami’s affection has increased to [ami_love]!
lines.zh: Ami 的好感度提升到了 [ami_love]!

lines.en: jump halloweentwo8
